# PCBDukaan

> PCBDukaan (pcbdukaan.com) is an Indian online store for industrial electronics and a component-level industrial PCB repair service. It supplies factories, OEMs, panel builders and maintenance engineers across India with industrial control boards, SMPS and power supplies, VFD and motor-drive boards, PLC and I/O modules, load cells and weighing indicators, industrial sensors, relays and power components, HMIs, communication modules and test & repair tools. Prices are shown excluding 18% GST; GST invoices (with the buyer's company GSTIN) and cash on delivery are available across India.
